correctness.rationale: Using the exact balancing recurrence X_{n+2}=6X_{n+1}−X_n for B0=0,B1=1, C0=1,C1=3 and c0=−1,c1=1, the proof derives three initial square-window sums from Pell companion identities. Consecutive sliding-window differences are B_k B_{2n+k+2}, 8B_k B_{2n+k+2} and 8B_k B_{2n+k+1}; strong divisibility reduces each infinite GCD to an exact two-integer GCD. Dyadic valuations (v2(B_k)=v2(k)), ternary triplication and all other odd prime factors establish G_B(k)=gcd(k,B_k)/(2 if even k else 1), G_C(k)=gcd(k,B_k), and G_c(k)=gcd(k,3B_k) for odd k or gcd(k,B_k) for even k. These match the prior complete proofs. Independent exact integer checks for k≤31 with 12 windows in each family agree; finite checks are not used to justify the infinite GCD.
residual_risks: Only three homogeneous families, not the inhomogeneous squared-cobalancing sequence.
All-index infinity is justified by algebraic difference GCD reduction, not finite windows.
